name: gamemaker-kit
description: A GameMaker (GML) toolkit: a playable two-player starter game in one command, text-based levels, drop-in systems, safe scaffolding that clones your project's own .yy format, project map, unused-asset cleanup, rename-everywhere, Aseprite import, localization, automatic project checks, a GML reviewer, and guides for game feel, co-op input, performance and Steam release.
